name: Elada
title: Descendant of Ephraim
summary: Elada is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of Ephraim. He is known primarily through his lineage in the family tree of Ephraim. His sons were killed by men from Gath when they attempted to steal their livestock, which caused great grief for Ephraim.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Ephraim's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Elada is listed as a descendant of Ephraim in the genealogy of 1 Chronicles. His place in the lineage connects him to the tribe of Ephraim.

keyEvents.title: The Death of Ephraim's Sons
keyEvents.description: Men from Gath killed some of Ephraim's descendants because they went down to take their livestock. This brought great sorrow to Ephraim, who mourned for a long time.

keyEvents.title: Ephraim's Sorrow and Comfort
keyEvents.description: After the tragedy with his descendants, Ephraim mourned for many days, and his brothers came to comfort him. Later he had a new son whom he named Beriah.

keyEvents.title: The Lineage Continued Through Tahath
keyEvents.description: Eladah's son Tahath continued the lineage, which eventually led to Joshua, son of Nun, the great leader who brought Israel into the promised land.
